questions.stem: What is the correct balanced equation for the combustion of propane (C₃H₈)?
questions.explanation: Balancing: 3 C atoms need 3CO₂, 8 H atoms need 4H₂O. Oxygen on the right: (3 × 2) + 4 = 10 oxygen atoms, so we need 5O₂ on the left. Check: C: 3 = 3, H: 8 = 8, O: 10 = 10. The equation is balanced.
